title: At the Library
transcript:
Anna: Excuse me, where can I find books about English grammar?
Librarian: They are on the second shelf, next to the dictionaries.
Anna: Thank you. Can I borrow two books?
Librarian: Yes. You can borrow them for seven days.
Anna: Great. I will return them next Monday.

questions.explanation: Anna asks for English grammar books.
The librarian says they are on the second shelf.

questions.stem: How many books can Anna borrow?
questions.explanation: Anna asks to borrow two books.

questions.stem: When will Anna return the books?
questions.explanation: She says next Monday.

title: Weekend Plans
transcript:
Tom: What are you going to do this weekend?
Maya: I am going to visit my grandparents on Saturday.
Tom: That sounds nice. Will you go by bus?
Maya: No, my father will drive us there.
Tom: What about Sunday?
Maya: I will stay at home and study English.

questions.explanation: She will visit her grandparents.
She says Saturday.
Her father will drive them.

questions.stem: What will Maya do on Sunday?
questions.explanation: She will study English at home.

title: Missed the Bus
transcript: Yesterday morning, I woke up late. I looked at my watch and saw that it was eight thirty. My class started at nine. I left home quickly, but I missed the bus. I called my friend and asked for help. She picked me up on her motorcycle. We arrived at school five minutes before class.

questions.stem: Why was the speaker in a hurry?
questions.explanation: The speaker woke up late.

questions.stem: What time did the class start?
questions.explanation: Class started at nine.
The speaker missed the bus.

questions.stem: How did the speaker reach school?
questions.explanation: A friend picked the speaker up on a motorcycle.

title: At the Café
transcript:
Server: Good afternoon. What would you like to order?
Dina: I would like a cup of tea and a chicken sandwich, please.
Server: Would you like anything else?
Dina: No, thank you. How much is it?
Server: It is forty thousand rupiah.
Dina: Here you are. Thank you.

questions.explanation: She orders a cup of tea.
She orders a chicken sandwich.
The server says forty thousand rupiah.
She says no thank you.

title: A Rainy Afternoon
transcript: It was raining heavily yesterday afternoon. Rudi was reading a book while his sister was listening to music. Their mother was cooking dinner in the kitchen. Suddenly, the lights went out. Rudi found a flashlight, and his sister called their father. After ten minutes, the lights came back on.

questions.explanation: Rudi was reading a book.
His sister was listening to music.
The power went out.
He found a flashlight.

title: Asking for Directions
transcript:
Visitor: Excuse me, how can I get to the train station?
Local: Go straight along this road for about two hundred meters. Turn left at the traffic light. The station is next to the post office, on your right.
Visitor: Is it far from here?
Local: No, it is only a five minute walk.
Visitor: Thank you very much.

questions.stem: Where does the visitor want to go?
questions.explanation: The visitor asks for the station.

questions.stem: Where should the visitor turn left?
questions.explanation: The local says at the traffic light.

questions.stem: What is next to the station?
questions.explanation: The station is next to the post office.
The walk is five minutes.

title: A New Job
transcript: I have worked in a small office for three years, but I have just received an offer from a larger company. My manager has already congratulated me. I have not decided whether to accept the offer yet. I will talk with my family tonight, because the new office is far from my house.

questions.stem: How long has the speaker worked in the small office?
questions.explanation: For three years.
The speaker received an offer from a larger company.

questions.stem: Has the speaker accepted the offer?
questions.explanation: They have not decided yet.

questions.stem: Who will the speaker talk to tonight?
questions.explanation: They will talk with their family.

title: At the Clinic
transcript:
Doctor: Good morning. What seems to be the problem?
Patient: I have a headache, and I feel very tired.
Doctor: You should rest today and drink plenty of water. You must not drive if you feel dizzy.
Patient: Can I go back to work tomorrow?
Doctor: You may return if you feel better, but please call me if your symptoms get worse.

questions.stem: What problem does the patient have?
questions.explanation: The patient says they have a headache.
The doctor says rest and drink water.

questions.stem: When must the patient not drive?
questions.explanation: The doctor warns against driving if dizzy.

questions.stem: When may the patient go back to work?
questions.explanation: The doctor allows returning when feeling better.
